newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria budget deficit falls to 430 bln levs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria budget deficit falls to 430 bln levs.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit fell by some 5.82 billion levs at mid-July to 429.94 billion levs or 45.9 percent of the annual target, a Finance Ministry official said, quoting preliminary figures.
"The deficit stood at 429.94 billion levs on July 17," the official said without giving reasons for the fall.
Deficit at mid-July was around 2.66 percent of the nominal 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) of 16.15 trillion levs assumed in this year's budget.

The central government budget deficit for fiscal 1997, which in Bulgaria coincides with the calendar year, was projected at 6.2 percent of GDP with revenues seen at 27.3 percent of GDP and expenditures at 33.5 percent.
Revenues at mid-July amounted to 1.14 trillion levs or 43.03 percent of the annual target against expenditures of 1.57 trillion levs or 43.78 percent of target.
